items.title: Add a gated PLAN->INIT reopen transition to the story state machine
items.context: New backward edge PLAN->INIT guarded by canReopenToInit (owner-gated, requires a reason, allowed only pre-REVIEW from PLAN). Wire it into BOTH the xstate machine states and canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan so story_advance --phase=INIT from PLAN lands at INIT, the only phase where title/context is editable.
items.userSees: Running lattice story_advance {storyId:B-x,phase:INIT,reason:...} from a PLAN worktree prints: Story B-x advanced to INIT. Omitting reason prints a clear refusal; reopening from any non-PLAN phase is refused.

happy.desc: story_advance phase=INIT from a PLAN worktree with a reason lands the story at INIT

edge.desc: after reopening to INIT, checklist_update of the title succeeds because title/context is editable at INIT

adversarial.desc: reopen is refused when reason is missing, and refused from any non-PLAN phase such as DEV or REVIEW

verificationEvidence.note: The round-trip smoke asserts story_advance phase=INIT with a reason from a PLAN worktree lands the story at INIT (phaseOf===INIT).
The smoke asserts a reopen without a reason is refused (matches /reason of at least .. characters/) and the phase does not move.

items.title: Fix dev_start so a bounce from inside the worktree reuses the existing worktree instead of false-failing
items.context: In worktree.ts dev_start, resolve the existing worktree path and storyRel against the MAIN repo root (git --git-common-dir) rather than --show-toplevel, so the reuse early-return fires and the branch-content guard stops seeing a .worktrees/<id>/-prefixed path. Required so re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK from inside the worktree reuses rather than re-bootstraps.
items.userSees: Re-advancing lattice story_advance phase=INIT_CHECK from inside the existing worktree prints: Story B-x advanced to INIT_CHECK reusing the worktree, instead of: Branch story/B-x already exists but does not contain .worktrees/...

happy.desc: re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK from inside the existing worktree reuses it and does not emit the does-not-contain .worktrees false-fail

edge.desc: dev_start invoked from the main repo root still resolves and reuses the worktree byte-identically

adversarial.desc: when the worktree directory was deleted, dev_start re-bootstraps cleanly without the .worktrees-prefixed branch-content false-fail

verificationEvidence.note: Re-bound to current material: the round-trip smoke re-advances INIT->INIT_CHECK from inside the existing worktree and asserts no does-not-contain .worktrees false-fail. GREEN at current HEAD.

assertDevStartReuseFromMainAndRebootstrap: from the MAIN root, dev_start on a story with an existing worktree reuses it (reports already-exists / Path), exercising resolveWorktreePath main-root resolution + the reuse early-return.

assertDevStartReuseFromMainAndRebootstrap: deletes ONLY the worktree dir (NO external prune) and asserts dev_start re-bootstraps it ITSELF. dev_start now prunes its own stale worktree registration before git worktree add (F-008, worktree.ts). RED-verified: with that prune disabled the same test fails with the missing-but-already-registered git error.

items.title: Correct the contradictory title-freeze guidance to point at reopen-to-INIT
items.context: checklist.ts tells the user to story_advance back to INIT_CHECK to change title/context, but INIT_CHECK stays in titleContextProtectedPhases so title is still frozen there; only INIT allows edits. Update the guidance text to name the reopen-to-INIT path. Keep INIT_CHECK protected (no invariant change).
items.userSees: Attempting checklist_update of a title at PLAN prints a refusal that tells the user to story_advance --phase=INIT (not INIT_CHECK) to change title/context.

happy.desc: checklist_update of a title at PLAN prints a refusal that names story_advance --phase=INIT (reopen-to-INIT), not INIT_CHECK

edge.desc: the refusal text no longer instructs the user to go back to INIT_CHECK

adversarial.desc: title/context edits remain rejected at INIT_CHECK so the scope-freeze invariant is preserved

verificationEvidence.note: The smoke asserts a title edit at PLAN is refused and the refusal matches /reopen to INIT/ and shows phase:INIT, and does NOT say back to INIT_CHECK.
The smoke asserts a title edit at INIT_CHECK is rejected (frozenAtCheck.code != 0) and the corrected title is unchanged, proving INIT_CHECK stays frozen (scope-freeze invariant preserved).

items.title: Add a round-trip smoke proving the reopen recovery works from inside the worktree
items.context: Permanent smoke: story -> INIT_CHECK -> PLAN (commands run from inside the worktree), reopen to INIT, edit a checklist item title via checklist_update, re-freeze scope and re-run INIT review, re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK->PLAN; assert the title change persisted with no git surgery or hand-edited checklist.json. Must fail RED before the fix on both the missing PLAN->INIT edge and the dev_start path bug.
items.userSees: npm --prefix packages/main test (or test:all) runs plan-init-reopen-roundtrip-smoke and it PASSES (GREEN) after the fix; the same smoke FAILS (RED) against pre-fix code.

happy.desc: the plan-init-reopen round-trip smoke passes GREEN after the fix

edge.desc: the smoke runs entirely from inside the worktree with no git surgery and no hand-edited checklist.json

adversarial.desc: the same smoke fails RED against pre-fix code (missing PLAN->INIT edge and dev_start path bug)

verificationEvidence.note: The smoke passes GREEN after the fix (exit 0, prints the pass line), driving the full round-trip entirely inside the worktree.
RED proof: against the pre-fix code (git stash of the fix), the same smoke exits non-zero with Cannot transition from PLAN to INIT, confirming it fails RED before the fix and passes GREEN after.
